verdict.rationale: Modal's site says H100, A100 and A10G GPUs can be attached to any sandbox on demand with per-second billing, and the Sandbox SDK reference exposes a `gpu=` parameter alongside cpu/memory/region. A community builder independently reports building GPU-native CI runners on Modal Sandboxes. Missing for 10: an in-depth guide on GPU sandbox configuration (GPU type selection, multi-GPU counts, limits), and a concrete hands-on example of GPU code running inside a sandbox.
